title: 第1033章 三人小组讨论霍安第1032章 小白的疑惑2
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 青禾老祖说道：“还是有很大的不同的，墨渊帝朝那边，我们是完全没有办法确定的，
这边的事情，我们可以确定大部分的事情，这样，我们成功的概率就会很高。”
杨威老祖说道：“这件事，如果你真的那么想，你最后到底会成为什么样子，我也不知道，
你说的能确定的事情，到现在，也没有什么不同的变化，要知道，我们看到的也只是表面的东西，
如果他们在隐藏实力，我们也会失败的，我们现在最怕的就是失败，这么多人在盯着我们，
我们已经在决议会的事情上，得到很多了，要是这么冒失，真的出现这样的话，我们会很麻烦的。”
青禾老祖说道：“那也不能什么都不做吧？如果什么都不做，最后，不还是这样吗？”
杨威老祖说道：“我觉得韩骏说的没有错，如果我们现在做了，那么得到的不是我们想要的结果，
还不如不做，我们本身就和决议会有仇，如果再招惹一个势力，会很麻烦，不如还是针对决议会，至少，
不管成功与否，我们都不会有什么太大的损失，哪怕霍安他们身后，不是墨渊帝朝，只是冥乘风，
或者是冥乘风的人，我们都能有些胜算的机会，毕竟我们也不是一次就要将决议会的人，全部杀了，
只是需要暂时的利用这些人，对决议会进行冲击，然后再来判断霍安他们，身后的人，到底是谁，
如果真是墨渊帝朝，那么我们也能为之后的事情，调整状态，如果不是，同样，能为我们后面的事情，
调整方法。”
青禾老祖听后，也是低头思考了起来，随后便说道：“这件事，既然大家都有意见，
那么就不要做了，换个思路，我们先试探霍安他们的真假，然后再做其他打算。”
韩骏老祖说道：“好，这样是最稳妥的办法，他们让我们重新出来，就是为了更稳妥的发展，
这件事，至于其他的事情，等我们处理完决议会，再说吧。”
杨威老祖说道：“没错，现在直接说这些，还是有些太早了，我们现在的实力，也没有到了能同时，
面对两方人的准备，先处理完决议会，再说其他的，而且如果真的能剿灭决议会，我想，我们后面的事情，
会好处理的多，毕竟我们只要这么多，不会有人不同意的，现在环宇帝朝的地盘和决议会的地盘，那么大，
我们吃不下的，那些地方，总要有人去拿，那么如果我们能剿灭，这些地盘，我们可以优先分配的，
其他的，自然会给到我们自己的人，那么多跟着我们的势力，总不能什么都不给他们吧，
他们也要出力的。”
青禾老祖说道：“这件事，我知道了，我们还是商议一下，对决议会出手的事情吧，要到哪种程度，
这个很重要。”
杨威说道：“既然是试探霍安他们的底细，自然是要他们也出手，至于什么程度，那就从环宇帝朝开始吧，
反正现在的环宇帝朝那么大，他们的人，不可能都在，我们设置目标，我们和他们同时出击，解决问题。”
content_en:
Ancestor Qinghe said: "There is still a big difference. We have no way of determining where Emperor Mo Yuan is heading.
We can determine most of the things here, so our probability of success will be very high. "
Ancestor Yang Wei said: "If you really think about this, I don't know what you will become in the end.
The things you said are certain have not changed much until now. You know, what we see is only the surface.
If they are hiding their strength, we will also fail. What we fear most now is failure. So many people are staring at us.
We have already gained a lot from the resolution meeting. If we are so reckless and this happens, we will be in great trouble. "
Ancestor Qinghe said: "Then you can't do nothing, right? If you do nothing, won't it still be like this in the end?"
Ancestor Yang Wei said: "I think Han Jun is right. If we do it now, we will not get the results we want.
It is better not to do it. We will have a grudge against the resolution itself. If we provoke another force, it will be very troublesome. It is better to target the resolution meeting, at least.
Regardless of whether we succeed or not, we will not suffer any big losses, even if behind Huo An and the others, it is not the Mo Yuan Dynasty but Ming Chengfeng.
Or someone from Ming Chengfeng, we all have a chance of winning. After all, we are not going to kill all the people who met at once.
We just need to use these people temporarily to attack the Congress, and then judge Huo An and the others who are the people behind them.
If it is really the Mo Yuan Dynasty, then we can also adjust our status for what will happen next. If not, we can also adjust our status for what will happen next.
Adjustment method. "
After hearing this, Patriarch Qinghe lowered his head and started thinking, and then said: "Since everyone has an opinion on this matter,
Then don't do it. Instead, let's try another idea. Let's test Huo An's authenticity first, and then make other plans. "
Ancestor Han Jun said: "Okay, this is the safest way. They let us come out again just for a more stable development.
As for this matter, as for other matters, let's wait until we finish the resolution meeting. "
Ancestor Yang Wei said: "Yes, it is still too early to say this directly. Our current strength is not enough to be able to
Faced with the preparations of both parties, we must first deal with the resolution meeting and then talk about other things. And if we can really wipe out the resolution meeting, I think what we will do next will
It will be much easier to deal with. After all, we only have so many people, and no one will disagree. Now the territory of the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty and the territory of the Resolution Council are so big.
If we can't eat those places, someone has to take them. So if we can destroy them, we can give priority to these territories.
The rest will naturally be given to our own people. With so many forces following us, we can’t give them nothing.
They also have to contribute. "
Ancestor Qinghe said: "I know about this matter. Let's discuss how to take action against the Congress. To what extent?
This is very important. "
Yang Wei said: "Since we are testing the details of Huo An and the others, we naturally want them to take action. As for how far, let's start with the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty.
Anyway, the current Huanyu Imperial Dynasty is so big that it is impossible for all their people to be there. We set goals, and we attack at the same time as them to solve the problem. "
